comparison_baseline.kind: new shared library; no author-upstream baseline

method: Source-qualified AST inventory including private/nested definitions, existing-attribution and direct-literal screening, followed by primary-paper equation/table matching. Generic numerical controls and fixed regressions are not treated as empirical calibration. Inventory counts alone do not prove scientific correctness.
limits: Native defaults use rounded Planck-2018 values; the Colossus preset is identified separately. A background choice does not recalibrate halo fits.
Generic protocols, callback integration, polynomial expansions, grid controls and unit conversion identities do not acquire invented empirical calibrations.

colossus: Diemer (2018), COLOSSUS: A Python Toolkit for Cosmology, Large-scale Structure, and Dark Matter Halos.
growth: Carroll, Press & Turner (1992), The Cosmological Constant, Section 3.5.
ludlow: Ludlow et al. (2016), The mass-concentration-redshift relation of cold and warm dark matter haloes, Appendix C.
nfw: Navarro, Frenk & White (1997), A Universal Density Profile from Hierarchical Clustering.
planck: Planck Collaboration (2020), Planck 2018 results. VI. Cosmological parameters, Table 2.
